name: rex-cinemas
description: REX Cinemas — movie ticket booking platform (React + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend, Node + TypeScript + SQLite backend)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -c "#e31837,#38bdf8" -n "server,client" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "if(fs.existsSync('server/uploads')) fs.cpSync('server/uploads', 'client/dist/uploads', {recursive: true})"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
